summary: Adds a signed amount to living local-player health when targeting self or when within the indexed player rectangle, then caps health at maximum.

Other-player case adds only for x distance <=13, y distance <=9 and living local player.

open_questions: No direct source callers found; sign and permitted domain of amount depend on the caller.

summary: Returns equipped resource ability byte 0xA7 when its kind byte is 9, otherwise zero, assuming the selected item resource is valid.

open_questions: Caller must ensure a valid selected item: the function does not safely return zero for a null resource.
